_doc: Canonical stage list for the reel-speech world (one talking-head video -> one 9:16 captioned ad). Read by scripts/run.py; mirrors docs/pipeline.md's stage table and SKILL.md steps 3-11. `run` is the argv to spawn (cwd = skill dir), with {work} {source} {language} {skill} substituted. A stage with no `run` is a checkpoint: `block:true` halts run.py until `makes` exists (a genuine human decision); a checkpoint with no `makes` is advisory - printed once, never blocks. A stage runs when any `makes` path is missing or older than any `needs` path; else it is skipped. `needs`/`makes` are work-relative; a trailing / means 'non-empty directory'; {source} is the rush/ source file. `when` gates a stage on a config value.

stages.title: Correct the transcript
stages.note: Read build/transcript-raw.json and correct every sentence with the user (rule #5 - Whisper errs badly in colloquial Arabic). Write build/transcript-fixes.json ({fix:[[...]], hot:[...]}). Each sentence's word count must equal Whisper's for that sentence. See SKILL.md step 5.

stages.title: Review the script, drop sentences
stages.note: Run `edit_script.py show`, show the user the numbered script, and drop any repeated or unwanted sentence NOW - before scene design, because a drop shifts every downstream timestamp. `edit_script.py dupes` flags rephrased pairs. Nothing to cut -> continue.

stages.title: Design the scenes
stages.note: The core creative step. Either author config/scenes.json (motif names from scripts/motifs/index.json, params bound to build/captions.json) or rewrite the scene functions in <work>/compose.html. A scenes-less project renders with captions only - that is a valid choice, not a skip. See SKILL.md step 7.

stages.title: Place the sound cues
stages.note: Author build/sound-cues.json - at minimum {"outro": <end-card seconds>}, plus whoosh/thud/tap arrays at meaningful moments (<= 15 events/min, rule #1). See SKILL.md step 8.
